VBO:0200222.summary: Described as docile in an early twentieth-century survey, the Braque Dupuy was a French gun dog trained both to point game and to retrieve it. That account depicts a deliberate worker ranging over a limited area. In 1911, Gitane de Mirebeau appeared in both its breed class and the field-trialers’ class at a French dog show.
VBO:0200222.shortDescription: A historically docile French gun dog, trained to point and retrieve and described as ranging over a limited area.
